spanish: Yo estoy encantada de conocerte hoy en la fiesta.
english: I am pleased to meet you today at the party.

spanish: La amistad entre mis amigos es muy importante.
english: The friendship between my friends is very important.

spanish: El profesor es guapo e inteligente.
english: The teacher is handsome and intelligent.

spanish: Mi hermana es rubia y tiene ojos azules.
english: My sister is blond and has blue eyes.

spanish: Mi amiga es guapa y muy simpática.
english: My friend is good-looking and very nice.

spanish: Mi pelo es negro y muy largo.
english: My hair is black and very long.

spanish: Voy al supermercado para comprar comida.
english: I go to the supermarket to buy food.

spanish: La casa roja está delante de mi casa.
english: The red house is in front of my house.

spanish: La familia come en el comedor de la casa.
english: The family eats in the dining room of the house.

spanish: El libro está encima de la mesa.
english: The book is on top of the table.

spanish: Yo vivo abajo en el primer piso.
english: I live downstairs on the first floor.

spanish: Me gusta comer pollo con arroz y verduras.
english: I like to eat chicken with rice and vegetables.

spanish: El tomate rojo está fresco en la ensalada.
english: The red tomato is fresh in the salad.

spanish: Compro un paquete de pan en la tienda.
english: I buy a packet of bread in the store.

spanish: Llevo el carrito de compras al supermercado.
english: I take the shopping cart to the supermarket.

spanish: Pago en la caja del supermercado con dinero.
english: I pay at the supermarket checkout with money.

spanish: Mi cumpleaños es en julio y tengo una fiesta.
english: My birthday is in July and I have a party.

spanish: Comemos pastel de chocolate en la celebración.
english: We eat chocolate cake at the celebration.

spanish: Mi amigo me da un regalo para mi cumpleaños.
english: My friend gives me a gift for my birthday.

spanish: Enciendo la vela para la fiesta de cumpleaños.
english: I light the candle for the birthday party.

spanish: Los globos azules decoran mi sala para la fiesta.
english: The blue balloons decorate my room for the party.

spanish: Escribo en mi cuaderno durante la clase.
english: I write in my notebook during class.

spanish: La vela pequeña ilumina la habitación oscura.
english: The small candle lights the dark room.

spanish: Mi color favorito es el azul y el verde.
english: My favorite color is blue and green.

spanish: Bebo una bebida fría en el calor.
english: I drink a cold drink in the heat.

spanish: Enero es el primer mes del año nuevo.
english: January is the first month of the new year.

spanish: Marzo es un mes muy bonito en primavera.
english: March is a very beautiful month in spring.

spanish: En abril llueve mucho en mi país.
english: In April it rains a lot in my country.

spanish: Junio es caluroso y tengo vacaciones.
english: June is warm and I have vacation.

spanish: Julio es muy caliente y vamos a la playa.
english: July is very hot and we go to the beach.

spanish: En septiembre vuelvo a la escuela para estudiar.
english: In September I return to school to study.

spanish: Hacemos un viaje a la montaña en verano.
english: We take a trip to the mountain in summer.

spanish: La tradición de mi familia es comer juntos.
english: My family's tradition is eating together.

spanish: La pared blanca tiene un cuadro hermoso.
english: The white wall has a beautiful picture.

spanish: Miro el mapa para encontrar la ciudad.
english: I look at the map to find the city.

spanish: La celebración es muy grande y divertida.
english: The celebration is very big and fun.

spanish: Mi sorpresa favorita es una cena especial.
english: My favorite surprise is a special dinner.

spanish: Tengo cincuenta libros en mi biblioteca.
english: I have fifty books in my library.

spanish: ¿Cuándo es tu cumpleaños en el año?
english: When is your birthday in the year?

spanish: Comemos a mediodía cuando tenemos hambre.
english: We eat at noon when we are hungry.

spanish: Mi hermano juega al fútbol en el parque.
english: My brother plays football in the park.

spanish: Me encantan los deportes como fútbol y tenis.
english: I love sports like football and tennis.

spanish: La música clásica es hermosa y relajante.
english: Classical music is beautiful and relaxing.

spanish: Tengo muchos libros en mi casa para leer.
english: I have many books in my house to read.

spanish: Compruebo el ticket para ver el precio total.
english: I check the receipt to see the total price.

spanish: Recibo un ticket cuando compro en la tienda.
english: I receive a ticket when I shop in the store.

spanish: ¿Adónde vas después de la escuela hoy?
english: Where do you go after school today?

spanish: Te pido un favor para ayudar con tarea.
english: I ask you a favor to help with homework.

spanish: Mi amiga toca la guitarra muy bien.
english: My friend plays the guitar very well.

spanish: Mi casa tiene un piano antiguo en la sala.
english: My house has an old piano in the room.

spanish: Estudio el idioma español en la escuela.
english: I study the Spanish language in school.

spanish: Escribo la dirección en el sobre blanco.
english: I write the address on the white envelope.

spanish: Mi número de casa es cincuenta y cinco.
english: My house number is fifty-five.

spanish: Pido información sobre el horario del tren.
english: I ask for information about the train schedule.

spanish: La ciudad es grande con muchas personas.
english: The city is big with many people.

spanish: Mi país tiene montañas hermosas y playas.
english: My country has beautiful mountains and beaches.

spanish: El profesor enseña matemáticas en clase.
english: The teacher teaches mathematics in class.

spanish: La profesora de español es muy paciente.
english: The Spanish teacher is very patient.

spanish: Mi amigo y yo vamos al cine cada semana.
english: My friend and I go to the cinema every week.

spanish: La gente en el parque juega y habla.
english: The people in the park play and talk.

spanish: Pongo sal en la comida para que sepa bien.
english: I add salt to the food so it tastes good.

spanish: Pido ayuda cuando tengo problemas con tarea.
english: I ask for help when I have homework problems.

spanish: Bebo jugo de naranja en el desayuno.
english: I drink orange juice for breakfast.

spanish: Tomo un refresco frío en el verano.
english: I have a cold soft drink in the summer.

spanish: Ordeno la comida en el restaurante ahora.
english: I order the food at the restaurant now.

spanish: Leo el menú para elegir qué comer.
english: I read the menu to choose what to eat.

spanish: Recibo un mensaje de mi amiga por teléfono.
english: I receive a message from my friend by phone.

spanish: Nos sentamos en la terraza para beber café.
english: We sit on the terrace to drink coffee.

spanish: Leo un artículo interesante en el periódico.
english: I read an interesting article in the newspaper.

spanish: Mi novela favorita es muy emocionante.
english: My favorite novel is very exciting.

spanish: El gato gris duerme en el sofá todo el día.
english: The gray cat sleeps on the sofa all day.

spanish: Me siento en el sofá para ver la televisión.
english: I sit on the sofa to watch television.

spanish: No hay diferencia entre estos dos libros azules.
english: There is no difference between these two blue books.

spanish: En este momento estoy estudiando español.
english: At this moment I am studying Spanish.

spanish: Llamo a mi madre por teléfono cada día.
english: I call my mother by telephone every day.

spanish: Recibo una llamada importante de mi jefe.
english: I receive an important call from my boss.

spanish: Hay mucho ruido en la calle por la noche.
english: There is a lot of noise on the street at night.

spanish: Vamos a la estación para tomar el tren.
english: We go to the station to take the train.

spanish: El precio de la leche es muy alto.
english: The price of milk is very high.

spanish: Hay un cuadro de la montaña en la pared.
english: There is a painting of the mountain on the wall.

spanish: Llevo mi bolsa con libros a la escuela.
english: I carry my bag with books to school.

spanish: El edificio grande tiene treinta pisos.
english: The big building has thirty floors.

spanish: La torre en la ciudad es muy alta.
english: The tower in the city is very tall.

spanish: Cruzamos el puente para ir al otro lado.
english: We cross the bridge to go to the other side.

spanish: No entiendo esta cosa extraña en el bolsillo.
english: I do not understand this strange thing in the pocket.

spanish: La verdad es que no sé la respuesta.
english: The truth is that I do not know the answer.

spanish: ¡Esa película es genial y muy emocionante!
english: That movie is great and very exciting!

spanish: Me llevo un regalo de la tienda a mi casa.
english: I take a gift from the store to my house.

spanish: Tengo un recuerdo especial de mis vacaciones.
english: I have a special souvenir from my vacation.

spanish: Compro frutas frescas en el puesto del mercado.
english: I buy fresh fruit at the market stall.

spanish: Mi vestido es de seda y muy suave.
english: My dress is made of silk and very soft.

spanish: Llevo un sombrero rojo cuando salgo al sol.
english: I wear a red hat when I go out in the sun.

spanish: La ubicación de mi casa es en la calle principal.
english: The location of my house is on the main street.

spanish: Espero el semáforo verde para cruzar la calle.
english: I wait for the green traffic light to cross the street.

spanish: Me duele la cabeza cuando tengo estrés.
english: My head hurts when I have stress.

spanish: Tengo dolor en la garganta y tos fuerte.
english: I have a sore throat and a strong cough.

spanish: Me duele la espalda después de trabajar mucho.
english: My back hurts after working a lot.

spanish: Mi estómago duele y no puedo comer.
english: My stomach hurts and I cannot eat.

spanish: Me duele el pie cuando camino todo el día.
english: My foot hurts when I walk all day.

spanish: Mis ojos son marrones y grandes.
english: My eyes are brown and big.
